systems.name: RLCard limit-holdem
systems.license: MIT (installed rlcard-1.2.0 license file; historical Apache label was corrected upstream-in-campaign under old D007)
systems.citation: Zha, D., Bhat, Z., Lai, K.-H., Yang, F., Jiang, Z., Zhong, S., & Hu, X. (2019). RLCard: A toolkit for reinforcement learning in card games. arXiv:1910.04376.
systems.seed_handling: env.seed disabled; dealer stream = SeedSequence(seed).spawn child via RandomState-compatible logging/keyed wrapper installed BEFORE env reset; agent stream = spawned sibling
systems.arms: A: seat0 random policy; B: seat1 conservative policy; estimand = chips won by seat-0 agent over num_hands
systems.policy_preservation_requirement: under event-keyed constructions the requested per-arm policy MUST still govern action choice (random uses keyed uniforms; conservative uses its rule); enforced by tests

systems.name: 2D Ising Metropolis Monte Carlo
systems.citation: Dehigaspetiyage Don, S. Y. (2026). ising-monte-carlo-toolkit v0.1.0 [Computer software]. GitHub.
systems.lattice: L=20; sweeps=90 measured + 20 equilibration; pure-python draw-transparent path
systems.arms: A: T=2.269; B: T=2.9; estimand = mean|magnetization| difference over measured sweeps
systems.rng_contract: wrapper replaces the sampler's RNG source BEFORE construction and integration tests assert the sampler actually consumes it (draw-count audit); if impossible under the pinned toolkit the affected keyed constructions are DELETED for this system before freeze rather than faked

notes: Identical fault mechanics implemented once in harness layer shared by both system wrappers (truncate/burn/think-budget/module-cache/queue-tax/dup-rows/persistent-state/collision/drift/repeat plumbing).
Third-system policy: none in this campaign.
